claim_text: AEON says its system was accessed without authorization
summary: AEON Credit Service (Asia) says in an 'Important Notice' on its website that it recently detected unauthorized access to its system.
detail: The notice does not say how, when or by whom. RTHK, The Standard, HK01, Metro Radio and the Hong Kong Economic Journal all report the notice.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: AEON's own notice says so, and RTHK and The Standard independently report it.

claim_text: The card portal and app were offline for more than 40 hours from Nov 18
summary: AEON's online services and mobile app showed 'system maintenance' from the evening of Wed Nov 18; Dimsum Daily reported them still down, more than 40 hours in, at 2 PM on Fri Nov 20 (HK time).
detail: The Standard, Metro Radio and the Hong Kong Economic Journal say services resumed on Saturday, Nov 21. Cardholders could not see statements or repay online, and some could not finish app-based checks for online shopping. Corrected Nov 22: the 40-hour count was as of Nov 20, not Nov 21.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Several outlets with different owners report the dates; Dimsum Daily's Nov 20 article gives the 40-hour count as of 2 PM that day, and The Standard, Metro Radio and the Hong Kong Economic Journal give Nov 21 as the day services came back.

claim_text: AEON has not said the outage and the intrusion are the same event
summary: AEON's notice does not mention the outage or the 'system maintenance' message. The outlets link the two; the company has not.
detail: The timing fits, but the notice only says it 'recently' detected unauthorized access.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice is silent on the link; the link is the outlets' reading.

claim_text: AEON acted to contain the incident and hired outside forensics experts
summary: AEON says it acted at once to contain the incident and strengthen system security, and hired independent third-party cybersecurity and digital forensics experts.
detail: This is the company's account; no outside check has been published.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The company says so, and RTHK reports it.

claim_text: AEON says it has found no evidence any data was misused
summary: AEON says that to date it has found no evidence that any relevant data has been misused.
detail: 'No evidence so far' is not proof of nothing; the company has not said what data was reached.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: AEON states the finding, and two outlets report it. It is a statement about what has been found, with limits.

claim_text: What data was reached, and how many customers
summary: AEON's notice does not say what data was reached or how many customers were affected.
detail: It says it will notify affected customers individually.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice gives no data types and no counts.

claim_text: AEON will notify affected customers and asks cardholders to stay alert
summary: AEON says affected customers will be notified individually about the steps taken to protect them, and asks customers to report any suspicious or unauthorized activity.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notice says so, and The Standard reports it.

claim_text: How the intruder got in, and who did it
summary: No source says how the access was gained, whether ransomware was involved, or who was behind it.
detail: No group has claimed responsibility in any source we read.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The notice and the news reports give no cause and no actor.

claim_text: A Hong Kong privacy or banking regulator has said something about this incident
summary: We found no statement from the Hong Kong privacy commissioner's office or the Hong Kong Monetary Authority about the AEON incident.
detail: The privacy office has handled earlier AEON-related data cases and has made statements on other 2026 incidents. We found nothing on this one.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the sources mention a regulator.
